title: KPGS vNext Phase 0 — Truth and Contracts
outcome: Establish canonical machine-readable and human-readable contracts for Stateless Renters, specification-first agent governance, and fork assimilation before runtime implementation begins.

included: Canonical Stateless Renter lifecycle and event envelope

constraints: No fork-derived code import before provenance and license compatibility are verified
No production domain rewrites during Phase 0
All artifacts must be inspectable as plain text in the repository

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Stateless Renter protocol defines destroy-and-rehydrate continuity without duplicate durable side effects.
The renter event envelope contains tenant, domain, task, renter, correlation and lease identifiers.
The build specification schema requires explicit scope, acceptance criteria, verification and rollback plans.
The fork matrix contains the 15 repositories in the 2026-08-14 through 2026-08-17 assimilation window with explicit disposition and audit status.
No fork marked with pending or unverified licensing is automatically classified for canonical import.

verification_plan.evidence: Protocol lifecycle and rehydration test section
verification_plan.command_or_procedure: Inspect stateless-renter/PROTOCOL.md and run the Phase 0 validator.

verification_plan.evidence: Assimilation policy and per-fork license/disposition fields
verification_plan.command_or_procedure: Run the Phase 0 validator and review any audit-blocked entries.

rollback_plan.trigger: Phase 0 contracts create an invalid governance assumption or break repository CI.
rollback_plan.procedure: Revert the Phase 0 commits as a unit, restore the previous governance tree, and reopen the affected acceptance criterion before reimplementation.
